result.summary: Found 2 issues: an untranslated localization key shown as a section title, and a restaurant name clipped in the fastest-near-you row beyond expected carousel overflow.

issues.description: The popular restaurants section heading displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and verify localization files include this key.

issues.description: The third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word under the card, not just at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines or use ellipsis so the name remains readable without looking broken.
